summary: Strong test suite with comprehensive coverage of core requirements: secret loading, expiration detection, warning windows, report generation, markdown/JSON output, error handling, and GitHub Actions integration. Excellent edge case testing (boundary conditions, date calculations, missing optional fields). Well-organized with clear test naming, good fixtures (New-TestSecret helper, parameterized cases), and proper Pester idioms. Gaps: CLI entry point (Invoke-SecretRotationValidator.ps1) untested in unit tests, $FailOnExpired switch only tested via act, empty secrets array not tested, some malformed-data scenarios missing. Overall would catch most regressions effectively.
